name: unsafe fn advance_unchecked (& mut self , n : usize) -> & mut Self
rule: The caller must ensure that the first `n` bytes of the cursor have been properly initialized before calling `advance_unchecked(n)`.
api: impl < 'a > core::io::borrowed_buf::BorrowedCursor < 'a > { unsafe fn advance_unchecked (& mut self , n : usize) -> & mut Self }
expression: $1.buf.filled + $2 <= len($1.buf.buf) and all([byte.$mem.initialized for byte in $1.buf.buf if $1.buf.buf.$mem.start + $1.buf.filled <= byte.$mem.start < $1.buf.buf.$mem.start + $1.buf.filled + $2])
